messages.subject: Summer stats camp
parts:
Hi all

I am part of the group that works on the Stats Camp (www.statscamp.org) which offers a variety of week long stats courses in June. Several courses are center around SEM, and offer code material in lavaan.

I teach the Bayesian SEM course, for which I use blavaan, as it is the best BSEM program


Hope to see some of you there
